# Theming and tokens

> Plainkit 0.1.0-alpha.1. Generated by scripts/build-skills.mjs from core/tokens/tokens.css. Do not edit: change the source and run the generator.

Two themes and two densities are token sets, never separate stylesheets: set `data-theme="dark"` or `data-theme="light"` (and optionally `data-density="compact"`) on `<html>` or on any element to theme only that subtree. Every colour, size, space and shadow is a CSS custom property (253 declarations in the token stylesheet); use them, never literal colours. `dist/js/theme.js` exports `MAX_OVERRIDES`, `MAX_VALUE_LENGTH`, `buildOverrides`, `colourToHex`, `currentTheme`, `nameProblem`, `parseOverrides`, `parseTokenBlocks`, `sanitizeDict`, `sanitizeOverrides`, `setTheme`, `splitLength`, `toggleTheme`, `tokenKind`, `valueProblem`. To change a token, override it in a stylesheet you load after `plainkit.css` (an inline `style` attribute is blocked by the CSP; setting properties from script through `element.style.setProperty` is fine). `mountThemeEditor` (see `tools.md`) edits and exports these overrides.

```css
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
    --color-accent: #7c3aed;
}
:root[data-theme="light"] {
    --color-accent: #6d28d9;
}
```
